notes.title: EX-EVIL EXES COME TOGETHER IN SCOTT PILGRIM EX
notes.content:
[p]Since we announced Scott Pilgrim EX back in June, we’ve loved watching everyone speculate about who the rest of the seven playable characters might be. Well, it wouldn’t be Scott Pilgrim [b]EX[/b] if we didn’t bring a few of our favorite exes into the fray, right? 
[/p][p]Roxie Richter and Lucas Lee are the first to join Scott Pilgrim and Ramona Flowers as playable characters in this new beat ‘em up brawler coming in 2026![/p][p][/p][p]🎬Lucas takes a break from Hollywood stardom to lay the smack down on any baddies standing in his way, with grappling prowess and a fully-weaponized skateboard (meaning he hits people with it).
[/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649528/fadd8efc206fb871adc5650b4761eb6ee14a848f.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649528/2cd51ef0e0240f9840fc9b6157fd390eedc2b1ba.gif"][/img][/carousel][p]🥷Roxie meanwhile brings her signature sword-slicing and dicing into the fray as a quick-hitting, speedy half-ninja, with a kit complete with smoke bombs and moves that turn her into a blender on the battlefield.[/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649528/bd1da6349a8738e9e9ba90a73d0260d1d42a27f1.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649528/aa50a34a4d4b1147f575eb4487cc64c947d244a6.gif"][/img][/carousel][p]Watch Roxie and Lucas mop the floor with some of the goons who have laid claim to Toronto in the new character reveal trailer:[/p][previewyoutube="RMZ2JNJq5s4;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][b]Hands-On at Gamescom 2025![/b][/p][p]We showed off Lucas and Roxie for the first time during Gamescom 2025, where the press got hands-on with a new playable demo and the early return has been pretty great so far:[/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649528/7f281cc5ffbd4210605293e7c8f475bf841bd848.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649528/458e83567925b2f04fb24d10d751a4f597356eb9.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649528/e5823b0e978f9f174fbf637c4c5077d59ef4c35b.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649528/36a76c6848f3c657b7d21f65f8c812762c21e6ed.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][i]"Scott Pilgrim EX is shaping up to be a fitting continuation of the series while bringing in enough fresh ideas to make me want to dive back in and see all it has to offer. It is fun, colourful and impressively smooth."[/i][/p][p][i]- Brendan Frye, CGMagazine[/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]"Scott Pilgrim EX seems like a snappy and modern beat 'em up with a surprisingly open design."[/i][/p][p][i]- Lexi Luddy, Shacknews
[/i][/p][p]"[i]Thirty minutes wasn't enough to see just how wide Scott Pilgrim EX goes, but what I've already seen has me excited at the prospects.[/i]"[/p][p]- Wesley LeBlanc, Game Informer
[/p][p]Seeing this kind of reaction makes us feel like we’re headed in the right direction, and we’re not stopping here!
[/p][p][b]Scott Pilgrim EX[/b] launches in 2026, with lots more news coming your way before then!  [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2640950/Scott_Pilgrim_EX"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Stay in the loop by following us on social media!:[/p][p][url="https://x.com/TributeGames"]X - Tribute Games[/url][/p][p][url="https://bsky.app/profile/tributegames.com"]Bluesky - Tribute Games[/url][/p][p][url="https://www.facebook.com/TributeGames/"]Facebook - Tribute Games[/url][/p][p][url="https://www.instagram.com/tribute_games/?hl=en"]Instagram - Tribute Games[/url][/p][p][url="https://www.tiktok.com/@tribute_games"]TikTok - Tribute Games[/url][/p][p][url="https://www.youtube.com/@TributeGames"]YouTube - Tribute Games[/url][/p][p][/p][p]And join us on our [url="https://discord.gg/A9MY2amd"]Discord server![/url][/p]

notes.title: The Best of Gamescom 2025: CGMs Favourite Titles This Year
notes.content:
CGMagazine had a full team on the gamescom 2025 show floor, and we worked hard to go hands-on with as many titles as time would allow. We spent the week running the massive halls of the Koelnmesse and saw everything from a massive World of Warcraft: Midnight portal to a Zenless Zone Zero Aston Martin. We played extraction shooters, strategy games, horror titles galore and cozy games so cute we couldn’t handle it.

After playing more than 50 titles over four days, CGM has chosen its picks for Best of Gamescom 2025. These games left us craving more hands-on time, pushing us to ask developers questions and, in some cases, begging for release dates. Whether it was a fresh take on a genre like The Blood of Dawnwalker, a long-awaited return like Hollow Knight: Silksong, or a title so unsettling it hasn’t left our minds like REANIMAL, these are our choices for Best of Gamescom 2025.

notes.title: Gamescom 2025: Scott Pilgrim EX Preview – Back To A Pixelated Toronto
notes.content:
It can be surreal to play a game that fully embraces Toronto, Canada, while in Cologne, Germany, but that was the pleasure I had on my second day of gamescom when I sat down to jump into Scott Pilgrim EX. Developed by Tribute Games Inc., the same studio that brought the world Mercenary Kings in 2014, the game looks to capture the spirit of Ubisoft’s Scott Pilgrim vs. the World: The Game while expanding the concept in new and exciting ways. After about 30 minutes with three other players, Scott Pilgrim EX proved to be a pixel-fuelled fever dream that is hard to forget.

First announced in June of this year, Scott Pilgrim EX brings to life the characters many fans know and love, while giving them a new story to explore and new locations to experience, all in a unique and colourful pixel-art style that is bubbly, fun and at times bananas. notes.title: Scott Pilgrim EX SDCC & Gameplay Sneak Peek!
notes.content: [p]San Diego got a face full of hard-hitting Canadian brawler action with a panel from Scott Pilgrim franchise creator Bryan Lee O’Malley, developer and publisher Tribute Games, Limited Run Games, and Universal Products & Experiences on [i]Scott Pilgrim EX[/i] that included a lively discussion and a first-look at a gameplay teaser showcasing the start of Scott Pilgrim’s latest adventure.[/p][p][/p][p]The panel included [b]Bryan Lee O’Malley[/b] as well as Tribute Games President [b]Jean-Francois Major[/b], Tribute Games Narrative Designer [b]Yannick Belzil[/b], Limited Run Games CEO [b]Josh Fairhurst[/b], Universal Products & Experiences Executive Producer [b]John Melchior[/b] and was moderated by Blank Check Podcast host [b]Griffin Newman[/b]. [/p][p][/p][p]The panel dove into the game’s place in the franchise as a brand-new adventure in its ever-growing universe. Bringing some in-universe music to the show, acclaimed rock band and Scott Pilgrim alumni Anamanaguchi’s [b]Peter Berkman[/b] made a surprise appearance to chat about the group’s involvement in creating [i]Scott Pilgrim EX’[/i]s soundtrack and showcase a brand-new track from the game!
